title: Representing a limit perfect object over the coordinate colimit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram, $c$ a colimit cocone, $i\in I$, $Z$ an affine scheme and $t:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}R_i$ a morphism. Use $F,Y,b$ of [def-pc-affine-descent-ring-diagram], and choose the scheme and open-site derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For every perfect $E\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-perfect-complex], there exists a bounded cochain complex $P$ of finite projective modules over $\operatorname{colim}F$ with $\operatorname{affineDescentRealization}(Y,\operatorname{colim}F,\operatorname{colim}.desc\ b)(P)\cong E$. No stage or descended object is asserted.

proof.text: Use the canonical spectrum comparison q:Y→Spec(colim F). It is an isomorphism. Its inverse induces an exact derived equivalence. Perfectness gives quasi-coherent homology, so transport E through that equivalence; the inverse preserves both perfectness and quasi-coherence.

Apply perfect_iff_affine_bounded_projective on Spec(colim F). Pullback along q is pushforward along its inverse by uniqueness of left adjoints. Map this natural isomorphism to complexes, apply derived localization and compose with the equivalence comparison and counit. The resulting functor is the explicitly defined realization.

theorem exists_affine_descent_colimit_model
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (i : I)
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Z] (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hc : IsColimit c)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))))
    (hE : (pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))).IsPerfect E) :
    ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (colimit (affineDescentRings R i t) : CommRingCat.{u})) ℤ,
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (colimit (affineDescentRings R i t) : CommRingCat.{u}) (P.X n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective (colimit (affineDescentRings R i t) : CommRingCat.{u}) (P.X n)) ∧
      Nonempty ((affineDescentRealization (pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (colimit (affineDescentRings R i t) : CommRingCat.{u})
        (colimit.desc _ (affineDescentRingCocone R i t c))).obj P ≅ E)
